subject: Coaching readiness checklist & plan for Nikhil — pre-PIP coordination
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Flag: Nikhil - pre-PIP coaching plan request

Team — quick context: Nikhil's quota attainment has slipped the last two quarters (50% & 62%) and there have been repeated coaching notes (low activity on CRM, missed 1:1s). Before we consider formal PIP, I'd like to prepare a documented coaching path (expectations, measurable milestones, cadence) that we can present to him and HR.

Can you help draft something that is explicit but constructive — 30/60-day checkpoints, required activities, and clear consequences if no improvement? I want a version that: 1) is coaching-first, 2) gives him an opportunity to improve, and 3) preserves process for escalation if needed.

Priority: this week. Availability: I can join a calibration call on Wednesday afternoon.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Flag: Nikhil - pre-PIP coaching plan request

Thanks David — draft attached (coaching_plan_nikhil_v1.docx). High level summary below; comments in the doc where I want HR input.

Why this approach
- Keep it coaching-focused: explicit expectations, weekly checkpoints, and documented support.
- Avoid triggering PIP language until we do one 30-day coaching cycle unless no progress.

Draft plan (summary)
- Duration: 30 days initial coaching window, followed by 30-day review.
- Owner: Stephanie (direct manager) — weekly 1:1s + midweek check-ins.
- Activities required of Nikhil:
  - Minimum 15 outbound activities/week logged in CRM (calls/emails/seq steps).
  - Update opportunity statuses daily and attach notes to each active opp.
  - 2 product demos scheduled with AE support in 30 days.
- Success metrics (objective):
  - Activity up to >=75% of peer median by day 30.
  - Pipeline coverage >= 1.2x quota within 60 days or demonstrable closed actions.
- Manager commitments:
  - Provide call shadowing twice/week, share specific playbook items, and provide templates for outreach.
  - Coordinate with RevOps to remove process friction identified in week 1.
- HR involvement:
  - Monica to review wording for compliance and documentation retention; HR will be included in the formal 30-day review meeting.
- Communication plan with employee:
  - One-on-one kickoff with documented expectations, then weekly follow-ups. First kickoff meeting scheduled once HR signs off.

Open items
- Legal/HR review for wording around consequences (avoid PIP until we decide).
- Any historical accommodations on file? Monica, please confirm.

Attaching: coaching_plan_nikhil_v1.docx (edits inline)

Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Manager, East Coast
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Flag: Nikhil - pre-PIP coaching plan request

Thanks for the draft, Stephanie — I reviewed and left comments in hr_review_notes.pdf and the attached doc. A few suggestions before we show to Nikhil: 

1) Metrics: tighten objective metrics where possible. For example, specify "15 logged outbound activities with at least 8 meaningful touches (calls or meetings)" rather than generic activity counts.
2) Timeline: change language to "30-day coaching window with formal review" (we should avoid 'trial' phrasing).
3) Documentation: ensure every weekly note is shared to a private HR folder; do not include any medical/PII.
4) Accommodations: HR confirms no formal accommodations on file but add a line asking employee if there are any personal constraints to performance.
5) Witness: add a second manager (David) as optional attendee for the 30-day review to verify fairness and calibration.

I also recommend scheduling a 30-minute calibration call with David + you + me tomorrow 10:30–11:00 to sign off, and then we can schedule the kickoff with Nikhil.

Monica
Monica Patel
HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-12-01T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Action: 1:1 Kickoff & Coaching Plan (please review)

Hi Nikhil — following our internal calibration, attached is the coaching plan we discussed (coaching_plan_nikhil_v1.docx). I want to be transparent: this is a structured coaching plan, not a PIP. The purpose is to give you clear, measurable targets and support for the next 30 days.

Key points for you to review before our kickoff meeting:
- Start date: 2026-12-03.
- Weekly cadence: 30-minute focused 1:1s (Tuesdays) + brief midweek check-ins.
- Required activity expectations: 15 logged outbound activities/week with at least 8 meaningful touches (calls/meetings).
- Manager support: call shadowing, outreach templates, and joint pipeline review.
- Assessment: objective metrics reviewed at day 30; HR attends the review.

Please reply to this thread acknowledging receipt and flag any concerns. I want to ensure we capture your perspective and any constraints you have. If you prefer a live walkthrough to review the document before the kickoff, let me know and I can send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Steph
